alternatives.labelRationale: The visible label was reviewed after completion of the 24-course curriculum and accurately presents this option as the closest feasible UCR response to Bachelor Bestuurskunde, rather than as a narrower subfield.

alternatives.concept: A climate and sustainability governance route that keeps a public-administration core while shifting substantial curricular weight toward sustainability policy, climate challenges, environmental governance and environmental justice.

alternatives.distinctnessRationale: Compared with the closest match, this route replaces seven courses (52.5 EC) with sustainability and environmental-governance study. The changed courses are consequences of the evidenced climate-policy direction, not threshold-filling substitutions.

alternativeSelection.assessment: Two alternatives are included. The closest match is retained. A second, evidence-backed climate and sustainability governance route differs by seven courses / 52.5 EC. The previously proposed law/institutions and public-organisation routes are not retained because they did not clear the 30 EC / four-course distinctness floor without arbitrary substitutions.

notes.text: The Erasmus programme integrates public administration, policy, law, sociology, economics, management, methods, an internship and a bachelor project. UCR can combine politics, sociology, law, economics, organisation and leadership, research methods, and—where relevant—environmental governance, but does not offer a dedicated Public Administration curriculum with the same structured internship and bachelor-project sequence.
